error_chain.expected_solution: Cross-repo propagation chain: (1) slf4j's LoggerFactory binds at runtime to log4j-slf4j-impl which exposes a Log4jLogger that forwards each call to log4j2's AbstractLogger.logMessage -> (2) When the appender chain includes AsyncAppender, log events enter a blocking queue or LMAX Disruptor ring depending on configuration -> (3) log4j2's AsyncAppender uses AsyncQueueFullPolicy to decide what to do when the queue is full; the default Discard policy drops events below ERROR level -> (4) Under burst load the ring buffer fills, AsyncQueueFullPolicy.Discard drops INFO/DEBUG events silently, and slf4j callers see Logger.info() return without a thrown exception.
